children: ICICI Securities's research report on Afcons Infrastructure

Afcons’ weak Q2FY27 stemmed from continued execution bottlenecks with delayed payments and land acquisition/ approval issues in select projects. Revenue declined 12% YoY to INR 26.4bn, while EBITDA margin contracted 750bps YoY to 3.5%, including the impact of a one-time provision. PAT stood at INR 0.4bn. With the execution uncertainty persisting alongside elevated working capital requirements, management has refrained from providing a FY27 guidance. While order inflows (OI) have picked up, with YTD inflows of INR 194bn, timely execution and cash conversion remain key monitorable. Its order book (OB; including L1) stands at INR 472bn (4.3x TTM revenue), providing healthy revenue visibility. Maintain HOLD with a revised TP of INR 230.
We maintain HOLD with a revised TP of INR 230 (earlier INR 315), based on 12x FY28E earnings.
